description: cardea: a session note on where to look things up, a block on reading private keys, a blind mode (CARDEA_BLIND=1) that denies every tool call showing the reference frontend, the commit message format, an approval prompt for commits that mention an AI tool or company, a once-a-session nudge before the web, and a once-a-session handoff nudge near autocompact.

hooks.command: "$([ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] && echo py || echo python3)" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook.py" session
"$([ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] && echo py || echo python3)" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook.py" secrets
[ "${CARDEA_BLIND:-}" = 1 ] || exit 0; "$([ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] && echo py || echo python3)" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook.py" blind
"$([ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] && echo py || echo python3)" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook.py" commit
"$([ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] && echo py || echo python3)" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook.py" web
"$([ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] && echo py || echo python3)" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook.py" handoff
